description: Données Ouvertes sur les Routes et Passages Piétons au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Transports. Les données sur les routes et passages piétons au Togo fournissent des informations essentielles sur les infrastructures de transport et de sécurité autour des zones stratégiques, notamment les aéroports et les centres urbains. Elles incluent la localisation des routes, leur état, la signalisation routière, ainsi que la présence de passages piétons sécurisés. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Transports. Its tags are passages, passages-pietons, pietons, routes. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-01-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support walking and cycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
